services.name: Product Catalog Service
services.responsibility: Manages product metadata, inventory counts, categories, and full-text search indexing.
services.database: Document DB (MongoDB / PostgreSQL JSONB) with Redis read cache for high-throughput reads.

services.name: Shopping Cart Service
services.responsibility: Stateful ephemeral cart management, coupon application, and Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC).
services.database: In-memory distributed key-value store (Redis / DynamoDB) with TTL expiration.

services.name: Order Management Service
services.responsibility: Checkout orchestration, state machine transitions (Pending -> Confirmed -> Shipped), and order history.
services.database: Relational ACID database (PostgreSQL) enforcing transactional integrity.
risks: Partial saga failure during payment timeouts

services.name: Payment Processing Service
services.responsibility: Payment gateway integration (Stripe/PayPal), SLA timeout enforcement (1500ms), idempotency deduplication, and saga compensation.
services.database: PostgreSQL with strict append-only financial audit ledger.

services.name: User & Identity Service
services.responsibility: Authentication, authorization, OAuth2/OIDC token issuance, and customer profile management.

trade_off_analysis.why_microservices: Enables independent scaling of Catalog (read-heavy, 10k users) vs Payment/Order (write-heavy ACID). Prevents cart crashes from taking down payment settlement.
trade_off_analysis.database_strategy: Database-per-service pattern prevents tight coupling, ensuring resilience against cascading outages.
